metadata.question: Does surface temperature decrease in non-water areas with higher vegetation density in New York City on August 14, 2002?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Does surface temperature decrease in non-water areas with higher vegetation density in New York City on August 14, 2002?" Interpretation: We need to check if there's a negative correlation between vegetation density (NDVI) and surface temperature (LST) in non-water areas of NYC on that specific date. Plan: 1. Data: Need surface temperature and vegetation index for August 14, 2002 in NYC. 2. Collections: Landsat 7 is operational in 2002. Use Landsat/LE07/C02/T1_L2 for surface temperature (ST_B10) and reflectance bands. 3. Geometry: Define NYC area (polygon around Manhattan or NYC bounds). 4. Date: Filter for August 14, 2002 ± 7 days to get a cloud-free image. 5. Processing: - Compute NDVI from bands B4 (NIR) and B3 (Red). - Get surface temperature from ST_B10 (Kelvin), convert to Celsius. - Mask clouds using QA_PIXEL. - Mask water using NDWI (or water bit in QA_PIXEL) to get non-water areas. 6. Analysis: Compute correlation between NDVI and temperature over the region. - Use ee.Reducer.covariance to get correlation coefficient. - If correlation < 0 → A: Yes; else → B: No. 7. Edge cases: - No image: Try Landsat 5 as fallback. If still empty → C1. - No valid pixels after masking → C2. - Invalid correlation (NaN/None) → C3. We'll output: - Print image ID, date, valid pixel count, correlation. - Final tag. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const nyc = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-74.3, 40.5, -73.7, 40.9]); // NYC bounding box const date = '2002-08-14'; const startDate = ee.Date(date).advance(-7, 'day'); const endDate = ee.Date(date).advance(7, 'day'); // Helper function to mask clouds and shadows for Landsat 7 function maskL7sr(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudShadowBitMask = 1 << 3; const cloudsBitMask = 1 << 4; const waterBitMask = 1 << 7; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudsBitMask).eq(0)) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(waterBitMask).eq(0)); // non-water return image.updateMask(mask); } // Helper to get and process image from a collection async function getProcessedImage(collectionName) { let col = ee.ImageCollection(collectionName) .filterBounds(nyc) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .map(maskL7sr); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) return null; // Get median composite to reduce noise let image = col.median().clip(nyc); // Compute NDVI const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['SR_B4', 'SR_B3']).rename('NDVI'); // Get surface temperature in Celsius (ST_B10 is in Kelvin) const temp = image.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0) // to Kelvin .subtract(273.15).rename('LST_C'); // to Celsius // Combine bands image = image.addBands([ndvi, temp]); // Mask out extreme values (optional, but helps with outliers) image = image.updateMask( image.select('NDVI').gt(-1).and(image.select('NDVI').lt(1)) .and(image.select('LST_C').gt(-50)).and(image.select('LST_C').lt(60)) ); return image; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let image = null; let source = ''; // Try Landsat 7 first image = await getProcessedImage('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2'); if (image) { source = 'Landsat7'; } else { // Try Landsat 5 as fallback image = await getProcessedImage('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2'); if (image) { source = 'Landsat5'; } } if (!image) { console.log(`No images found for ${date} ±7 days.`); console.log('C1'); return; } console.log(`Using ${source}, date range: ${startDate.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()} to ${endDate.format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo()}`); // 3. Check valid pixels const count = image.select('NDVI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: nyc, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); if (count === 0) { console.log(`Valid pixels: 0`); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Calculate correlation between NDVI and temperature const covar = image.select(['NDVI', 'LST_C']).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.covariance(), geometry: nyc, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, }).getInfo(); const covMatrix = covar['array']; const ndviVar = covMatrix[0][0]; const lstVar = covMatrix[1][1]; const covariance = covMatrix[0][1]; // Avoid division by zero let correlation = null; if (ndviVar > 0 && lstVar > 0) { correlation = covariance / Math.sqrt(ndviVar * lstVar); } console.log(`Valid pixels: ${count}`); console.log(`Correlation (NDVI vs LST): ${correlation !== null ? correlation.toFixed(3) : 'NaN'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (correlation === null || isNaN(correlation) || Math.abs(correlation) > 1) { console.log('C3'); } else if (correlation < 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
